metadata.name: OpenTubeX
metadata.summary: Privacy-focused desktop YouTube frontend client with enhanced customization

content.value: OpenTubeX is an open-source, privacy-respecting desktop client for YouTube, originally developed as a fork of FreeTube. It allows you to watch videos without advertisements or tracking, storing subscriptions, playlists, and watch history locally on your device without requiring a Google account.
Designed for maximum control, OpenTubeX enables tailored feed management, flexible multi-tab browsing, and granular playback configurations.

items.value: Group channel subscriptions into customizable profiles with filters for videos, Shorts, live streams, or posts
Integrated SponsorBlock support to skip sponsored segments or exempt specific channels
Per-channel playback preferences including playback speed, video resolution, and silence skipping
Tabbed browsing interface with persistent queues, mini-player mode, and desktop session restore
Optional local recommendation engine ranking unwatched videos based on on-device viewing activity
